description: Source code implementing weight normalization functions and utilities for the ATen library in PyTorch, including CPU implementations, dispatch definitions, and related tensor operations.

methods.name: norm_except_dim
methods.description: Computes the norm of a tensor along a specified dimension, with special handling for -1, 0, and last dimension.

methods.name: weight_norm_cpu
methods.description: CPU implementation of weight normalization, returning the normalized weights and their norms.

methods.name: weight_norm_backward_cpu
methods.description: CPU implementation of the backward pass for weight normalization, computing gradients w.r.t. v and g.

methods.name: _weight_norm
methods.description: Performs weight normalization, using fused or non-fused methods depending on the dimension.

methods.name: _weight_norm_differentiable_backward
methods.description: Differentiable backward path for weight normalization, used when backward creates a graph.
